provenance.existing: spec section 6.3 confirms that appearance craft and performance tuning are both core content, and section 6.2 lists appearance as one of six evaluation dimensions. The hours feed the same capacity model as design/components and design/economy-candidate.
provenance.new: The four finish levels, their consumable cost, their added labour and their appearance points are original game balance.
provenance.limits: A numeric model for the appearance score only. What each finish looks like, how it is drawn and how the player applies it belong to the workbench and art workstreams.

rules.oneLevelPerMachine: A machine carries exactly one finish level, chosen when the design is saved
rules.craftToolsApply: The craft tools investment reduces finish labour the same way it reduces commission assembly hours
rules.appearanceIsNotFree: Every level above standard costs consumables and workshop time, so a high appearance score competes with output
